name: Morph
blurb: A private, decentralized browser with local AI built in. The browser is one part of the app, next to chat, notes, projects, and a peer-to-peer web on Weirdnet.

name: Weirdnet
blurb: Open-source Rust crates for peer-to-peer apps: a libp2p node, signed key exchanges and invitations, sealed messaging, identities, relays, and the building blocks Morph, Muninn, TAUR and Salty Gull share.

name: Mouser
blurb: A terminal emulator written in Rust with GPU rendering, tabs, an SSH connection manager, compressed scrollback and the Fuzzball graphics and keyboard protocol.

name: Fuzzball
blurb: Encoder and decoder for the Fuzzball terminal protocol: DCS Fz keyboard, graphics, shell and plugin messages. Rust, no dependencies.

name: Muninn
blurb: Data goes in, your magic transforms it. Ingest from CSV, JSON, HTTP APIs, Redis, SQLite and Postgres; export to CSV, Parquet or JSON; browse it in a TUI.

name: Ymir
blurb: Turns your own computers into one private cloud of LLM models, shared over Weirdnet. No hosted service, no open ports, no API keys.

name: Bragi
blurb: The chat app for your own Ymir cloud, on desktop and phone. It pairs with your own devices over Weirdnet and streams answers from models on your own machines.

name: itcmdr
blurb: Self-healing IT for small offices. An agent on every PC checks the network, connections and services each night and repairs what it safely can.

name: Grindvakt
blurb: A secure, user-mode DNS updater for DNSimple and DigitalOcean, with a local encrypted vault and a systemd, launchd or Windows service.

name: TAUR
blurb: An AUR-compatible package server in Rust. yay and other AUR helpers can search, inspect and clone packages from it.

name: TAUR Packages
blurb: The public TAUR package server, an AUR-compatible service you can search and clone from. Point yay or paru at it to install packages.

name: grokbot-tui
blurb: A terminal UI for Grok Bot, written in Rust with ratatui and crossterm.
